retention.oldEvidence: Do not edit original frozen source, builds or evidence. New work and reports stay in new worktree.
retention.failures: Retain all failed attempts, raw results, stdout/stderr and source/build identities. Fix a concrete defect before any declared rerun; no choosing quiet winners.
retention.decision: Correctness is mandatory. Report all performance runs and uncertainty; do not call the smooth-gameplay goal achieved solely from lower correction counts, desktop averages or partial input coverage.
retention.publication: Local commits only; no push, merge or deployment.
